/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/TKEngine.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/TKEngine.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/TKEngine.dir/objects1.rsp
